AFTER THE AIRCRAFT WAS FERRIED TO DAYTON, MAINTENANCE ALSO REPLACED THE ENGINE IN ACCORDANCE WITH DORNIER MAINTENANCE MANUAL 71-02-02.  OPERATIONAL CHECKS WERE PERFORMED AND THE AIRCRAFT WAS RELEASED FOR SERVICE.

DURING TAKEOFF, THE CREW RECEIVED A RIGHT HAND ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT FAIL MESSAGE AND ABORTED TAKEOFF.  THE AIRCRAFT CLEARED THE RUNWAY AND THE CREW REFERENCED THE QUICK REFERENCE HANDBOOK AND RESET THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT.  THE CREW THEN ATTEMPTED ANOTHER TAKEOFF AND DEPARTED WITHOUT INCIDENT.

AFTER DEPARTING DCA EN ROUTE TO BTV, THE CREW EXPERIENCED A RIGHT HAND ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT FAILURE.  IT RESET AND OCCURRED TWO MORE TIMES.  THE THIRD TIME THE CREW DID NOT ATTEMPT TO RESET IT.  THE FLIGHT HAD BEEN CONFERRING THROUGH DISPATCH AND MAINTENANCE CONTROL AND WERE THEN INSTRUCTED TO DIVERT TO PIT FOR MAINTENANCE.  MAINTENANCE INSPECTED AND CLEANED THE CANNON PLUGS IN ACCORDANCE WITH DORNIER MAINTENANCE MANUAL 73-21-00.  OPERATIONALS CHECKS WERE PERFORMED AND THE AIRCRAFT WAS RELEASED FOR SERVICE.

DURING PREFLIGHT, THE CREW NOTICED THAT THE EMERGENCY DOOR AT THE 1 D & F SEAT POSITION HAD APPEARED TO HAVE BEEN TAMPERED WITH FROM THE OUTSIDE.  THE CREW CONTINUED THE PREFLIGHT AND FOUND NOTHING ELSE OUT OF PLACE OR SUSPICIOUS.  OUTSTATION MAINTENANCE INSPECTED AND RESECURED THE EMERGENCY DOOR IN ACCORDANCE WITH DORNIER MAINTENANCE MANUAL 52-00-00.

WHILE ON APPROACH, THE CREW DECLARED AN EMERGENCY DUE TO LOW  AND FLUCTUATING OIL PRESSURE ON THE RIGHT HAND ENGINE.  THE AIRCRAFT LANDED WITHOUT INCIDENT.  MAINTENANCE INSPECTED AND REPLACED THE RIGHT HAND PITCH CONTROL UNIT QAD IN ACCORDANCE WITH DORNIER MAINTENANCE MANUAL 61-21-00.  OPERATIONAL CHECKS WERE PERFORMED AND THE AIRCRAFT WAS RELEASED FOR SERVICE.
